items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: I started working with Al Denny's band and then I worked with Al Denny up until a fellow came to town named Lee Dare

ctx.x: Yes, this was during the Depression. And so one day, I heard a band playing and heard the music. So I followed the music, you know, kept following the sound. Kept following it until I came to a place and I could tell the band

was upstairs playing. It was Al Denny. His band was rehearsing. He had about a 12-piece band. So I went upstairs, just walked on in, went upstairs and sat down and listened to him. They didn't have a piano player. So I heard the musicians talking, "We don't know what we're going to do for a piano player." Said, "We got to do something. We got to get one from somewhere."
